Dear Mr. Horton:
From February 5, 2020 through February 9, 2021, a representative of the Pipeline and Hazardous
Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), pursuant to Chapter
601 of 49 United States Code (U.S.C.) inspected your natural gas pipeline facilities of your
subsidiary, Gulf South Pipeline Company, LLC, (Gulf South or Operator) in Louisiana and
Texas.
As a result of the inspection, it is alleged that you have committed probable violations of the
Pipeline Safety Regulations, Title 49, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR). The items inspected
and the probable violations are:
1.

§ 192.201 Required capacity of pressure relieving and limiting stations.
